title: Targeted Neuromodulation of the Left Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex Alleviates Altered Affective Response Evaluation in Lonely Individuals
description: This dataset comprises EEG and behavioral recordings from a study examining the effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) over the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex on emotion processing and regulation in lonely individuals. 120 participants completed two sessions (sham and active stimulation) involving an emotion regulation task with static social and non-social images, rated on arousal and valence. The dataset includes raw EEG, behavioral ratings, and derived ERP data, along with questionnaires assessing side effects and blinding effectiveness.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 64-channel QuickCap (32 active electrodes) and a Neuroscan SynampsRT amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate, with impedance kept below 10 kΩ. tDCS was delivered via a Starstim 8 system (Neuroelectrics) targeting left or right dlPFC (anode F3/F4, returns at surrounding sites) at 2 mA for 20 minutes with ramp-up, or sham stimulation. Preprocessing was performed in MATLAB using EEGLAB and ERPLAB, including band-pass filtering (0.1–30 Hz), downsampling to 250 Hz, re-referencing to average mastoids, bad-channel detection, ICA-based artifact removal (ADJUST, SASICA), epoching (-200 to 5000 ms), baseline correction, and artifact rejection based on amplitude and FASTER metrics, followed by condition-wise ERP averaging.
